title: Kimi K3 the OpenAI Killer? I Tested It on a Real Project
description:
Kimi K3 is hyped as the OpenAI and Anthropic killer on benchmarks. Total lie 😅 I ran it on my own real project against Fable 5, Opus 4.8 and GPT 5.6, and it came out noticably weaker. It even rebuilt 3D models that was already sitting in the project 🔥 Worse, it opened files on its own i never asked it to touch. Benchmarks lie, test yourself ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
